description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS—on a task evaluated by a metric labeled “Average Performance,” which ranges from 0 to 60 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the five methods in that order, with each represented by a distinct color: Standard (orange), Self-RAG (light brown), FactTune (light green), CInGS (w/) (blue-gray), and CInGS (dark blue). The bars are of similar height, indicating comparable performance across methods, with CInGS achieving the highest score at approximately 58, followed closely by CInGS (w/) at around 54, Self-RAG at about 53, Standard at roughly 52, and FactTune at approximately 51. The chart includes a light gray legend square in the top-left corner, though no corresponding label is visible, suggesting it may be a placeholder or artifact. The y-axis is marked with dashed horizontal gridlines at intervals of 10, aiding in value estimation. The chart visually emphasizes CInGS as the top-performing method, consistent with the paper’s focus on Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.
